_comment: Canonical gate is devkit/scripts/budget.mjs, enrolled 2026-11-16. Comments are excluded from every line count on purpose: the portfolio does not ration documentation. Caps sit close to what was measured that day, so growth is noticed on the commit that causes it.
_code_comment: NAMED FILES, NO DIRS. The authored logic is the two root scripts; there is no src/ to point at, and putting '.' in dirs would sweep every tool file that arrives next without anyone deciding. WHAT THIS CANNOT SEE: the inline <script> blocks in the HTML pages (the theme toggle on every page, JSON-LD on the home page), which no row counts because they live inside files that are mostly markup. A page that grows real logic inline is code nobody measures; move it into a named .js file.
_deps_comment: ZERO, AND THE ZERO IS THE POINT. This site has no build and Cloudflare Pages serves this directory as it stands, so a runtime dependency has nowhere to be bundled; it could only arrive as a hosted script tag, which this row cannot see (gtag is one, loaded by consent.js after a visitor allows analytics). It also keeps the repo with no node_modules for Pages to install.
_assets_comment: TWO ROWS, raw rather than gzipped because woff2 and webp are already compressed. FONTS: six faces from four families. IMAGES: the portfolio pictures under images/, the largest thing a visitor downloads, weighed as a whole. WHAT THIS CANNOT SEE: the HTML pages and stylesheets at the root, which no row weighs because an asset row walks a directory and the root holds the repo itself; and which images a given page loads, so one heavy project page hides in the total.
_caps_comment: MEASURED 2026-11-16: code 180 lines, fonts 232.0 KB, images 6436.5 KB. Each cap is a few percent above, so the next project page's pictures or a seventh font face is a red row and a decision rather than a drift.
